title: lpbot: runs
description: Every run of an experiment side by side. Results, fees and gas are in the value token.

list.name: experiment
list.label: Experiment
list.query: select distinct experiment from runs order by 1
list.definition: select distinct experiment from runs order by 1

targets.rawSql:
select run_id, patience, width_ticks, pool, value_token, result_pct, fees, gas, campaigns, passes, max_drawdown_pct, halted_by_loss_limit, mode, window_from, window_to, capital_usd, loss_limit_pct
from runs
where experiment = '$experiment'
order by run_index

panels.title: Result by run, in percent of the starting capital

targets.rawSql:
select patience || ' / ' || width_ticks as run, result_pct
from runs
where experiment = '$experiment'
order by run_index

panels.title: Result by range width and patience rule

targets.rawSql:
select width_ticks,
  max(result_pct) filter (where patience = 'adaptive') as adaptive,
  max(result_pct) filter (where patience = 'wait') as wait,
  max(result_pct) filter (where patience = 'flip') as flip,
  max(result_pct) filter (where patience = 'close') as close
from runs
where experiment = '$experiment'
group by width_ticks
order by width_ticks

panels.description: One row per width, one column per rule. The adaptive decision has to beat the three fixed rules.

targets.rawSql:
select r.patience, r.width_ticks, c.exit_reason, count(*) as campaigns, sum(c.result) as result, sum(c.fees) as fees, sum(c.passes) as passes
from campaigns c join runs r using (run_id)
where r.experiment = '$experiment'
group by 1, 2, 3
order by 2, 1, 3
